Execution

GPU runs are compared with the integer reference before commit.



Operator genes
Change the phase turns and gain banks, or supply a byte-tape program. Gene changes enter the same round log as ticks.


Checkpoint & replay
The initial pinion checkpoint is 32 bytes. Its 768 mutable row flags add 96 bytes when needed. Mutation inputs pack eight ticks per byte.


Peer hops
Create an offer on one device. Answer it in another browser or with the native GPU host, then return the answer. A round commits after both member slots arrive, in A → B order.
ICE configuration
